description:
Berg-Kragerø Museum stands beside the Helle Fjord in Kragerø. Its manor-house setting provides a starting point for exploring local history, coastal culture and life around the fjord.

Exhibitions and interpretation address holiday life, the ice-export trade of the sailing-ship era and Edvard Munch’s connections with Kragerø. The surrounding estate includes parkland and nature trails.

Objects associated with expeditions by Fridtjof Nansen and Roald Amundsen form an important part of its holdings. The museum’s development is closely connected with the Holmenkollen ski-jumping site.

description:
The Theodor Kittelsen Museum occupies the former cobalt-mining site on Skuterudhøyden near Vikersund. Part of Blaafarveværket, it opened in 1993 following an initiative involving the artist’s surviving children.

Sculpture, drawings, woodcuts and other media trace his artistic development. Plaster originals for major works in Vigeland Park connect the museum’s studio collections with the nearby sculpture landscape.
